name: meatspace_log_workout
description: Log a workout / exercise session to Meatspace tracking. Use when the user says "log a workout", "I went for a 30 minute run", "did an hour of yoga", "lifted weights for 45 minutes". The `type` is free-form (run, yoga, lifting, cycling, swim, etc.). Duration and intensity are optional.

durationMinutes.description: How long, in minutes. Omit if unknown.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes about the session.
